note: Set A covers more of the page's substantive rules correctly, including the non-decathlete prohibition, the three permitted host-decathlete functions, the required menu/recipe/ingredient submissions, the 6+2 guest breakdown, and that outdoor grilling equipment may be built into the prototype. Set B adds two facts A omits (meal served/eaten in the finished square footage at the designated eating area, and the per-item ingredient list), but it drops several other binding requirements. Both sets split the display sizes into separate inch and centimetre claims and both are otherwise faithful; A's only blemish is a duplicated meal-uniqueness claim. On balance A captures more correct, well-bound claims with no unsupported content.
